abstract: The relationships between AJFNHE (Kamei S: 2004) and anti-N-methyl-d-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) encephalitis (Dalmau J et al: 2007) is discussed. The comparative clinical features in both reports revealed that most were young adult women, a prodrome was presented in 80%, the first neurological symptom was psychosis, the main symptoms included convulsions, consciousness disturbance, and involuntary movements, and mechanical ventilation was required in 80%. Dalmau reported that ovarian teratoma was demonstrated in 11 out of 12 patients, and mediastinal teratoma in 1 patient. We had yet to examine these conditions at the time of publication. AJFNHE and anti-NMDAR encephalitis are thus considered to be the same condition. AJFNHE represents a clinical concept based on the specific clinical features, and anti-NMDAR encephalitis represents a clinical entity based on the neuro-oncological findings. A nationwide survey of AJFNHE was undertaken in Japan. Collected patients predominantly were young adult women. Their clinical features were uniform and also in concordance with those previously reported as AJFNHE. This survey revealed that the annual incidence was 0.33/10(6) population, respiratory failure was observed in 70% and required care with mechanical ventilation, associated tumors were demonstrated in 40% and ovarian teratoma was the most frequent.
abstract_ja: AJFNHE(Kamei S: 2004)と抗N-メチル-D-アスパラギン酸受容体(NMDAR)脳炎(Dalmau J ら: 2007)との関係について考察する。両報告の臨床像を比較すると、大半は若年成人女性であり、80%に前駆症状がみられ、初発の神経症状は精神病症状であった。主な症状はけいれん、意識障害、不随意運動を含み、80%で人工呼吸管理を要した。Dalmauらは、12例中11例で卵巣奇形腫を、1例で縦隔奇形腫を認めたと報告した。本報告の発表時点では、我々はこれらの状態についてまだ検討していなかった。したがって、AJFNHEと抗NMDA受容体脳炎は同一の病態と考えられる。AJFNHEは特徴的な臨床像に基づく臨床概念であり、抗NMDA受容体脳炎は神経腫瘍学的所見に基づく臨床単位である。日本国内でAJFNHEの全国調査が実施された。収集された患者の大半は若年成人女性であった。臨床像は均一で、これまでにAJFNHEとして報告された症例とも一致していた。本調査では、年間発症率は人口100万人あたり0.33人であった。呼吸不全は70%に認められ人工呼吸管理を要した。関連腫瘍は40%に認められ、卵巣奇形腫が最も多かった。
